package processing_test

// Throwaway cross-check harness for xtandard-image WP-25 (internal/pipeline/plan).
// It runs imgproxy's real processing pipeline (with vips calls traced by
// vips/xi_trace.go) on synthetic sources and writes every geometry call to
// $XI_HARNESS_OUT as JSON.

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"image"
	"image/color"
	"image/gif"
	"image/jpeg"
	"image/png"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/clientfeatures"
	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/imagedata"
	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/imagetype"
	parser "github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/options/parser"
	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/processing"
	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/security"
	"github.com/imgproxy/imgproxy/v4/vips"
)

type xiSrc struct {
	Format      string `json:"format"`
	Width       int    `json:"width"`
	Height      int    `json:"height"`
	Orientation int    `json:"orientation,omitempty"`
	Alpha       bool   `json:"alpha,omitempty"`
	Frames      int    `json:"frames,omitempty"`
	// Trim: a uniform white border around an inner black rectangle.
	Inner []int `json:"inner,omitempty"` // l,t,w,h
}

type xiCase struct {
	Name  string   `json:"name"`
	Src   xiSrc    `json:"src"`
	URL   string   `json:"url"`
	Trace []string `json:"trace"`
	W     int      `json:"width"`
	H     int      `json:"height"`
	Err   string   `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func exifJPEG(b []byte, o int) []byte {
	if o <= 1 {
		return b
	}
	var t bytes.Buffer
	t.WriteString("II*\x00")
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(8))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint16(1))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint16(0x0112))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint16(3))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(1))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint16(o))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint16(0))
	binary.Write(&t, binary.LittleEndian, uint32(0))
	payload := append([]byte("Exif\x00\x00"), t.Bytes()...)
	seg := []byte{0xFF, 0xE1, byte((len(payload) + 2) >> 8), byte(len(payload) + 2)}
	out := append([]byte{}, b[:2]...)
	out = append(out, seg...)
	out = append(out, payload...)
	return append(out, b[2:]...)
}

func xiPattern(w, h int, alpha bool, inner []int) image.Image {
	img := image.NewNRGBA(image.Rect(0, 0, w, h))
	for y := range h {
		for x := range w {
			c := color.NRGBA{uint8(x * 255 / w), uint8(y * 255 / h), 128, 255}
			if alpha && (x+y)%3 == 0 {
				c.A = 100
			}
			if inner != nil {
				c = color.NRGBA{255, 255, 255, 255}
				if x >= inner[0] && x < inner[0]+inner[2] && y >= inner[1] && y < inner[1]+inner[3] {
					c = color.NRGBA{0, 0, 0, 255}
				}
			}
			img.Set(x, y, c)
		}
	}
	return img
}

func xiMake(t *testing.T, s xiSrc) imagedata.ImageData {
	img := xiPattern(s.Width, s.Height, s.Alpha, s.Inner)
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	switch s.Format {
	case "jpeg":
		if err := jpeg.Encode(&buf, img, &jpeg.Options{Quality: 70}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return imagedata.NewFromBytesWithFormat(imagetype.JPEG, exifJPEG(buf.Bytes(), s.Orientation))
	case "png", "webp":
		if err := png.Encode(&buf, img); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if s.Format == "png" {
			return imagedata.NewFromBytesWithFormat(imagetype.PNG, buf.Bytes())
		}
		dir := t.TempDir()
		in, out := filepath.Join(dir, "a.png"), filepath.Join(dir, "a.webp")
		os.WriteFile(in, buf.Bytes(), 0o644)
		if b, err := exec.Command("vips", "copy", in, out).CombinedOutput(); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(string(b))
		}
		b, _ := os.ReadFile(out)
		return imagedata.NewFromBytesWithFormat(imagetype.WEBP, b)
	case "gif":
		g := &gif.GIF{}
		pal := color.Palette{color.Black, color.White, color.RGBA{255, 0, 0, 255}, color.RGBA{0, 0, 255, 255}}
		for i := range s.Frames {
			p := image.NewPaletted(image.Rect(0, 0, s.Width, s.Height), pal)
			for y := range s.Height {
				for x := range s.Width {
					p.SetColorIndex(x, y, uint8((x/10+y/10+i)%4))
				}
			}
			g.Image = append(g.Image, p)
			g.Delay = append(g.Delay, 10)
		}
		if err := gif.EncodeAll(&buf, g); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		return imagedata.NewFromBytesWithFormat(imagetype.GIF, buf.Bytes())
	case "svg":
		fmt.Fprintf(&buf, `<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="%d" height="%d"><rect width="%d" height="%d" fill="red"/></svg>`, s.Width, s.Height, s.Width/2, s.Height/2)
		return imagedata.NewFromBytesWithFormat(imagetype.SVG, buf.Bytes())
	}
	t.Fatalf("format %s", s.Format)
	return nil
}

func TestXIHarness(t *testing.T) {
	in := os.Getenv("XI_HARNESS_IN")
	out := os.Getenv("XI_HARNESS_OUT")
	if in == "" {
		t.Skip("no XI_HARNESS_IN")
	}
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(in)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var cases []xiCase
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &cases); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	vc := vips.NewDefaultConfig()
	if err := vips.Init(&vc); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	pc := processing.NewDefaultConfig()
	pc.AlwaysRasterizeSvg = true
	sc := security.NewDefaultConfig()
	sc.MaxAnimationFrames = 256
	chk, err := security.New(&sc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	proc, err := processing.New(&pc, chk, nil)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	oc := parser.NewDefaultConfig()
	oc.AllowSecurityOptions = true
	prs, err := parser.New(context.Background(), &oc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	srcs := map[string]imagedata.ImageData{}
	for i := range cases {
		c := &cases[i]
		key := fmt.Sprintf("%+v", c.Src)
		data, ok := srcs[key]
		if !ok {
			data = xiMake(t, c.Src)
			srcs[key] = data
		}
		o, _, err := prs.ParsePath(context.Background(), "/"+c.URL+"/plain/local:///x", &clientfeatures.Features{})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("%s: %v", c.Name, err)
		}
		vips.Trace = nil
		res, err := proc.ProcessImage(context.Background(), data, o)
		c.Trace = vips.Trace
		if err != nil {
			c.Err = err.Error()
			continue
		}
		c.W, c.H = res.ResultWidth, res.ResultHeight
	}
	b, _ := json.MarshalIndent(cases, "", "  ")
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, b, 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
